title: Meeting with Mayor Raj Salwan
description1: Why we went: we want more students in our city to have access to robotics and STEM, and city leaders can help make that happen.
description2: Outcome: we built a connection between student robotics teams and city leadership, and learned how the Mayor's education plans could support more STEM programs.
bullets: Presented our team, FIRST, and what students learn through robotics
Talked with the Mayor about the future of technology and AI education
Asked for practical ways to expand STEM access and connect with community groups
